title: Exploring Three-Dimensional Cathodoluminescence Technique with FIB-SEM
content: Focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy (FIB-SEM) is an instrument that enables three-dimensional analysis of the internal microstructure in a sample by repeatedly performing cross-sectioning with high positional accuracy using FIB and cross-sectional imaging with SEM. Additionally, by detecting cathodoluminescence (CL) generated from a sample irradiated with an electron beam, it can be used to analyze crystallinity, impurities, and defects in microscopic regions.
